system.description:
The mage reads and subtly nudges the flow of probability, granting a stroke of good luck or inflicting bad luck on a target. In play the Storyteller applies a modifier to a single chance-based roll, such as a gamble, a trick shot, or an enemy’s fumble. It works best when framed as plausible coincidence.

Dice Pool: Manipulation + Occult (+1 die as a rote)

Adapted to M5 from M20 Entropy 1; mechanics paraphrased.
